title: Glowing train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rails -->
  <rect x='5' y='88' width='90' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6a5acd'/>
  <rect x='5' y='93' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4b3f9e'/>
  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='7' fill='#c9d6ff'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='20' r='5' fill='#aeb9f0'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='19' r='4.5' fill='#dbe3ff'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='26' y='26' width='10' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <rect x='24' y='24' width='14' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='52' y='40' width='26' height='30' rx='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='56' y='45' width='10' height='10' rx='2' fill='#fff4c2'/>
  <rect x='69' y='45' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#fff4c2'/>
  <rect x='52' y='66' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='#e0a83a'/>
  <!-- boiler body -->
  <rect x='16' y='48' width='38' height='22' rx='8' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='16' y='62' width='38' height='8' rx='4' fill='#d94848'/>
  <!-- boiler bands -->
  <rect x='28' y='48' width='3' height='22' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <rect x='40' y='48' width='3' height='22' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <!-- front lamp (glow) -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='56' r='5' fill='#fff6a8'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- funnel front -->
  <rect x='14' y='40' width='12' height='9' rx='3' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <rect x='12' y='38' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='9' fill='#7b6cf6'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='4' fill='#c3baff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='76' r='9' fill='#7b6cf6'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='76' r='4' fill='#c3baff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='76' r='9' fill='#7b6cf6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='76' r='4' fill='#c3baff'/>
  <!-- connecting rod -->
  <rect x='24' y='74' width='44' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b0a8ff'/>
  <!-- cowcatcher -->
  <polygon points='14,70 6,84 14,84' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
